slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

eyes up walking

walk through busy streets looking at faces instead of the ground. most people look away first, and you'll notice it every single time.

phone in the bag

keep your phone in your bag during every meal with friends. being fully there is so rare now that people actually feel it.

sentence restarts

when you stumble on a word, stop, smile and say the sentence again slowly. owning the restart looks more confident than never tripping at all.

learn like a kid

learn one new thing every day just because it's fun: an animal fact, an old myth, a word in latin. people who stay curious never look bored or boring.
slides.texte_sophia:
learn like a kid

learn one new thing every day just because it's fun. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app gives you 5 minutes of art, history or science. people who stay curious never look bored or boring.

slides.texte_overlay:
quiet wins list

every night, write down three things you handled well today, even tiny ones. confidence grows from proof, and you're finally keeping the receipts.
